summary: Flippo received an AIPAC endorsement and, in a July 2025 Real America's Voice appearance, blamed Hamas for the lack of aid reaching Gaza, stating 'they don't want to be part of society.' In October 2026 he touted humanitarian aid to Israel after Oct 7, crediting his own nonprofit with food delivery that records attribute to the Order of St. John. His documented public remarks center on defending Israel and attributing Palestinian hardship to Hamas.
